title.zh: 将马尼拉大都会达义 Western Bicutan 描笼涯的 Tenement 小学附属校分离，改设为独立的村长 Eddie T. Reyes 纪念小学，并为此拨款

Reyes Memorial Elementary School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Tiểu học Tenement tại Barangay Western Bicutan, Đô thị Taguig, Vùng Metro Manila khỏi Trường Tiểu học Tenement và chuyển thành Trường Tiểu học Độc lập với tên gọi Trường Tiểu học Tưởng niệm Kapitan Eddie T. Reyes, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Tenement ในบารังไกย์ Western Bicutan เทศบาล Taguig เขตมหานครมะนิลาออกจากโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Tenement และยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษาเอกเทศชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษาอนุสรณ์ Kapitan Eddie T. Reyes และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Dasar Tenement di Barangay Western Bicutan, Kotamadya Taguig, Wilayah Metropolitan Manila dari Sekolah Dasar Tenement dan menjadi Sekolah Dasar Mandiri dengan nama Sekolah Dasar Memorial Kapitan Eddie T. Reyes, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Rendah Tenement di Barangay Western Bicutan, Perbandaran Taguig, Wilayah Metropolitan Manila daripada Sekolah Rendah Tenement dan menjadi Sekolah Rendah Bebas dengan nama Sekolah Rendah Memorial Kapitan Eddie T. Reyes, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Tenement Elementary School Annex of the Tenement Elementary School in the Municipality of Taguig, Metro Manila is hereby separated from the Tenement Elementary School in Barangay Western Bicutan, Municipality of Taguig, Metro Manila and converted into a separate and independent elementary school to be known as the Kapitan Eddie T. Reyes Memorial Elementary School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

All assets, immovable and movable, records and personnel of the Tenement Elementary School Annex of the Tenement Elementary School, as well as their liabilities and obligations, are hereby retained with the newly created independent elementary school (Kapitan Eddie T. Reyes Memorial School): Provided, however, That the positions, rights and security of tenure of the personnel therein employed under existing laws shall not be impaired.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Tenement Elementary School Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Kapitan Eddie T. Reyes Memorial School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
